# Examples shell hosts the 21-group list on every route and opens on Start here

## Context

Leaf of `#21140` (`The examples section becomes Neo's kitchen sink`, cornerstone 1 of Engine 14 in `ROADMAP.md`, cut Mon 23 Nov). Implements Design 1, 2, 3, and 6, the 21-group re-cut (`The list`, 18 Nov `13:55Z`), and the folded half of `#21131` (closed into Shell on 18 Nov) in one cohesive Portal PR so the `Tiles` and `Find` lanes can stack cleanly.

## The Problem

On `dev` (`0128668721`), `/examples` renders `Overview.mjs` without the upright desktop navigation list (`GroupIndex`, presentation `'list'`), repeating every published group across `GroupList` overview cards, four band card sections, and the 4-band index while showing zero actual example cards. Group pages (`GroupPage.mjs`) mount 44 separate `GroupIndex` instances (`list` + `sheet`) and 22 `buildControl` instances across the cached `card` stack, render 2 columns instead of 3 at `1440×900` (`410px` minimum card width), omit the resting `"live examples"` / `"Open live"` cues and visible multi-window label (`#21131`), and still carry the pre-re-cut 22-group topology (4 bands, `timeline` group, unrenamed `Tree` / `Kanban Board` / `Tab Container`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainer.mjs:67–97, 158–196`: owns `familyDefinitions`, `catalog`, `groups`, `buildModes`, and the `card` stage (`removeInactiveCards: false`). Currently each `GroupPage` constructs its own `GroupIndex` (`list`), mobile crumb/`sheet`, and `buildControl`, while `Overview` sits at index `0` without the left navigation rail.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.mjs:96–141`: publishes `ExampleGroup` records (deriving `image` covers for `GroupList`) and switches `MainContainer.layout.activeIndex`.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/Overview.mjs:75–208` & `apps/portal/view/examples/GroupList.mjs`: build 3 `startFamilies` group cards, 4 band sections of group cards, and desktop `GroupIndex` (`overview`), duplicating navigation and showing no concrete example cards.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/GroupIndex.mjs:141–190`: assumes every group has a non-empty `band` string and omits `aria-current="page"` on `"All examples"` when on `/examples`.
- `apps/portal/model/ExampleGroup.mjs:44–80`: carries `image` / `tile` fields solely for `GroupList` and returns `"N example(s)"` rather than `"N live example(s)"`.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs:143–172` & `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css`: uses `minmax(min(100%, 410px), 1fr)` (yielding 2 columns at `1440×900`), renders `.neo-multi-window` as an icon-only circle without text/`aria-label`, and shows no resting open-live cue on the caption.
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:494–524` & `apps/portal/service/Seo.mjs:33–71`: validated 1:1 by `Generate.spec.mjs` and `Seo.spec.mjs` against `familyDefinitions`.
- Design authority: `#21140` body ("The target, Wed 18 Nov 2026" and "The list") approved on operator board read (`13:30Z`, `"i already like your new drafts"`), plus `#21140` Design 7 folding `#21131`.

## The Fix

1. **Hoist shared shell & navigation into `MainContainer.mjs` (`GroupPage.mjs` simplified):**
   - `MainContainer` (`layout: {ntype: 'grid'}`) renders once: `.portal-examples-group-crumb` (mobile crumb + `GroupIndex` `sheet`, hidden on desktop and on `/examples`), `.portal-examples-sidebar` (desktop `GroupIndex` `list`, ready for `Find` to prepend above `"All examples"`), and `.portal-examples-stage` (`card` layout holding `Overview` + published `GroupPage` cards with `removeInactiveCards: false`).
   - `MainContainerController` updates `MainContainer#syncNavigation(group)` and switches `stage.layout.activeIndex`.
   - `GroupPage` becomes a clean scrolling pane owning only its `.portal-examples-group-header` (`h1`, subtitle, `buildControl`) and `List` (`leadCard: true`).
2. **Apply the 21-group `"The list"` re-cut (`#21140`):**
   - Update `MainContainer#familyDefinitions` to 21 groups: unbanded `Apps` (`band: null`) first, followed by 5 bands (`Data views`, `Planning`, `Layout`, `Components`, `Platform`), renaming `Trees` (`tree`), `Task Board` (`board`, keeping `"kanban"` in sentence & SEO title), and `Tabs` (`tabs`), removing `timeline`, removing `tile`, and setting `tileHeading: 'Field types'` on `forms`.
   - Update `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`: set `timeline-basic` (`family: 'grid-table'`, `alsoIn: ['scheduler']`), add `'tree'` to `alsoIn` on `grid-tree` and `grid-tree-big-data`, rename `helix` from `"component.Helix"` to `"3D Helix"`, place the 12 `Start here` records first in `#21140` catalog order (`grid-big-data`, `workstation`, `grid-tree-big-data`, `dock-choreography`, `shared-covid`, `grid-issues`, `scheduler-basic`, `gantt-basic`, `board-basic`, `calendar`, `webdesktop`, `helix`) with `featured: true`, and set `featured: false` on all other records.
   - Align `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` (`EXAMPLE_FAMILY_SEO`), `apps/portal/service/Seo.mjs` (`routeTitles`), and regenerated `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`.
   - Update `GroupIndex.mjs` & `GroupIndex.css` to render unbanded groups above the first band section and mark `"All examples"` `aria-current="page"` when `activeFamily === null`.
3. **Transform `Overview.mjs` into `Start here` & retire `GroupList`:**
   - Remove `apps/portal/view/examples/GroupList.mjs`, `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/GroupList.css`, and `image` / `tile` fields from `ExampleGroup`.
   - `Overview.mjs` keeps the headline (`"<N> live examples in <M> groups"`), workers lead sentence, primary CTA buttons, and `"Start here"` header with `buildControl`, then renders a `Portal.view.examples.List` (`leadCard: true`, `showGroup: true`) bound to a chained `ExampleStore` filtering `item.featured && Example.publishes(item, catalogMode)`. Mobile (`<= 640px`) renders `GroupIndex` (`presentation: 'overview'`) below the cards only.
4. **3-column grid, `2×2` lead card, and folded `#21131` cues (`List.mjs` + `List.css`):**
   - Switch `.portal-examples-list` to 3 columns beside the sidebar at `1440×900` (`@container (min-width: 1040px)`), spanning `.portal-examples-list-with-lead > .neo-list-item:first-child` across `2 columns × 2 rows` with a `9:16` row/column gap ratio (`13.5px 24px`) so card bottoms align cleanly.
   - Render top-left group badges on `Start here` (`showGroup: true`), a visible `"Multi-window"` label + `aria-label` on `.neo-multi-window`, `"live example(s)"` in `ExampleGroup.countLabel`, and a resting `"Open live ↗"` caption cue (`>= 4.5:1` contrast, `opacity: 1`, `>= 45%` desktop / `>= 30%` phone clear cover, hidden on hover/focus/selection).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Desktop `/examples` (`1440×900`) and every `/examples/{group}` route display one hoisted left `GroupIndex` (`presentation: 'list'`, `.portal-examples-sidebar`) ordered per `#21140` "The list": `"All examples"` (`aria-current="page"` on `/examples`), unbanded `Apps`, then the 5 bands (`Data views`, `Planning`, `Layout`, `Components`, `Platform`), with `Trees`, `Task Board`, `Tabs`, and no `Timeline` group.
- [ ] Phone (`390×844`) keeps `Start here` cards + mobile-only banded `GroupIndex` (`overview`) below on `/examples`, and keeps the hoisted crumb + `GroupIndex` (`sheet`) on `/examples/{group}`.
- [ ] `Overview.mjs` renders `"Start here"` with the 12 catalog-ordered `featured: true` demonstrations (11 currently published; `board-basic` once covered), each with its home group pill, a `2×2` lead card and 3 card columns at `1440×900`; `GroupList` and `ExampleGroup` `tile`/`image` are deleted.
- [ ] Group pages render 3 columns with a `2×2` lead card at `1440×900`, `grid-tree` and `grid-tree-big-data` appear under `Trees` (`alsoIn: ['tree']`), `timeline-basic` sits under `Grid & Table` with `alsoIn: ['scheduler']`, `helix` renders as `"3D Helix"`, every count line uses `"live example(s)"`, every card caption shows a resting `>= 4.5:1` open-live cue leaving `>= 45%` desktop / `>= 30%` phone cover clear, and `.neo-multi-window` displays `"Multi-window"` with an accessible name.
- [ ] `node buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -t all -e dev`, `node buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs && node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`, unit specs (`MainContainerController.spec.mjs`, `Generate.spec.mjs`, `Verify.spec.mjs`, `Seo.spec.mjs`), and Whitebox E2E (`ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`) pass cleanly.
- [ ] **Look:** unlabelled before (`dev` `0128668721`) and after frames at `1440×900` and `390×844` (`/examples` and `/examples/grid`, dark and light themes) evaluated by two cold readers, both scoring `after > before` and naming opening a live example as the next action.

## Out of Scope

- `Find` cross-group filter input (`#21140` Design 8 — separate leaf ticket & stacked PR right after Shell).
- `Tiles` (`#21140` Design 4–5: `kind: 'component'`, 6-per-row dark workbench crop tiles, and crop recipes).
- Individual group slate renewals, new demonstrations, and `apps/portal/view/home/`.

## Avoided Traps

- Leaving `tileHeading` / `band: null` as non-literal expressions in `MainContainer#familyDefinitions` (breaks Acorn parsing in `seoJson.mjs#extractExampleFamilyDefinitions`).
- Leaving stale `/examples/timeline` or mismatched `/examples/{board,tabs,tree}` titles between `seoJson.mjs` and `Portal.service.Seo` (fails `Generate.spec.mjs` / `Seo.spec.mjs`).
- Creating another `GroupIndex` inside `Overview` or keeping 44 instances in `GroupPage` instead of hoisting into `MainContainer`.
